# Pacific time data

Moment Timezone 0.6.6 and America/Los_Angeles packed zone data, IANA 2026f.

Source: https://github.com/moment/moment-timezone — moment-timezone.js and data/packed/latest.json. Only the America/Los_Angeles zone is included; the library is unmodified. MIT license and copyright notice are retained in LICENSE-timezone and the library header. The zone bundle enables PST/PDT transitions without Intl or network requests. Update from upstream when time-zone rules change.
